name: Shikami Nanase
source:
"You're making fun of me, aren't you?"

Unemployed and has no fixed address. She lives in "Dooyoko," a shady part of town filled with lust, desire, and crime, where young people who have lost common sense, ethics, and higher thought hang out.

She's not very smart, but she's the type who has unfounded confidence in herself. She believes she can do anything if she tries hard, but she has never tried hard. She gets happy when praised, and gets carried away easily.

Her hobbies are games and manga. She's exceptionally good at games. She's picky about the taste of fast food.

She has a frail younger sister.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/emtneo/chara.html?page=chara5]official website[/url]]
